review.title: Add, rename and forget a workspace

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: Forget preview clearly names scratch and wraps full path/exact command. Amber warning states that files remain; confirm and cancel keys fit. Underlying selection cursor remains visible and list paths are clipped.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: State preserves Files are not deleted. Only jj workspace metadata is forgotten and the exact scratch operand. Warning is bold #eab855, title/control accents #65d4cf, body #e0e6ee on #242c3a; current star #269d9a remains behind the modal.

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: Add preview shows selected scratch context, full destination ending manual-added, derived name and complete wrapped command. The command reaches near controls but nothing overlaps or disappears.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: State retains destination workspaces/manual-added and --name manual-added, gray #a1aebe labels, bold command #e0e6ee and teal controls over slate. Underlying list paths clip but preview provides the full path.

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: List retains default, selected manual-renamed and scratch after collision. Footer displays the generic rename failure in plain text, without the specific already-exists cause; caption names the collision and later video opens full details.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: State contains Rename workspace failed: Error: Failed to rename a workspace, with the same styling as ordinary status. Both default and manual-renamed remain visible. Specific stderr cause is absent from this checkpoint and appears through Command History in the video.

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: Final list contains only default and scratch, with selection/current markers on default. Success footer and caption explain forgotten metadata and retained on-disk content. Long directory paths remain clipped.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: State shows Forget workspace metadata succeeded with C history and o operations routes, original two workspace names and teal current marker. No added/renamed registration remains; on-disk retention is verified separately by outcome assertions.

video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: 16 frames across 50.53 seconds plus full-resolution history/detail samples at 33.667 and 37 seconds show cancellation, actual add, metadata rename, failed default collision, C/Home selection of newest failed command, Status: exit 1 and Caused by: Workspace default already exists, successful manual-ready recovery, and metadata forget. Captions explain each transition; 2-3 second holds and 80ms typing allow reading. No fixture setup appears. Five outcome assertions prove original registrations/files survive, forgotten directory/files remain and rename does not change directories. The generic failure footer requires the demonstrated extra history navigation to expose its cause.
